SELECT pc.ProductCategoryName AS category,
       sumIf(f.SalesAmount, f.PromotionKey != 1) AS promo_revenue,
       sumIf(f.SalesAmount, f.PromotionKey = 1) AS full_price_revenue,
       sumIf(f.DiscountAmount, f.PromotionKey != 1) AS total_discount_given,
       sumIf(f.SalesAmount, f.PromotionKey != 1) - sumIf(f.SalesAmount, f.PromotionKey = 1) AS incremental_revenue_vs_full_price,
       (sumIf(f.SalesAmount, f.PromotionKey != 1) - sumIf(f.SalesAmount, f.PromotionKey = 1)) * 100.0
         / nullif(sumIf(f.SalesAmount, f.PromotionKey = 1), 0) AS incremental_pct
FROM retail.FactOnlineSales f
JOIN retail.DimProduct p ON f.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory ps ON p.ProductSubcategoryKey = ps.ProductSubcategoryKey
JOIN retail.DimProductCategory pc ON ps.ProductCategoryKey = pc.ProductCategoryKey
GROUP BY pc.ProductCategoryName
ORDER BY incremental_revenue_vs_full_price DESC
